== Specials ==

QWSM2 organized a FFA All Stars minitournament. It included two players from each QWSM clan. Tourney began with two qualification rounds. Six best players of both rounds qualified to the final.

* Winner: [[Fix]]
* Runner up: [[Dare]]
* Third: [[Rat]]
